bug_semantics: GET /api/system/logs, GET /api/system/logs/stream, and WS /ws/system/logs expose historical and live server logs (caller paths, stack traces, structured fields) to any authenticated user. AuthRouterGroup only ran JWTAuthMiddleware; the dashboard handler and service performed no admin/role/scope check, and the WS handler only jwt.ParseToken. A registered non-admin can read and stream logs for reconnaissance.
flaw_origin: Original system-log feature. fcbe5084a4f095760ac691039ef1999ce50db333 first added GetSystemLogs, SSESubscribeSystemLogs, and WSSubscribeSystemLogs and registered them on AuthRouterGroup/WSRouterGroup in internal/router/dashboard.go with no RequireScopes or ensureAdmin. Parent 51690dd61a629f7a0f1728583c6de55282699e70 had dashboard metrics routes only and no system/logs symbols. RequireScopes did not exist until later (b47fa1c7, 2026-03-23). Closing HTTP/SSE change is 6df5673010720847e35d8bb8f60403e2cc4ab313 wrapping those two GET routes with middleware.RequireScopes(ScopeAdminSettings); WS stayed ParseToken-only at that commit and at v4.4.3.
ai_marker: Absent on BIC fcbe5084a4f095760ac691039ef1999ce50db333. git cat-file -p shows author and committer L1nSn0w <l1nsn0w@qq.com> and a human subject/body about logging config and dashboard log retrieval/subscription; no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, Assisted-by, bot identity, or other AI trailer.
evidence: First-party GHSA-w8jj-cwmc-wgq2 (CVE-2026-79669) describes CWE-862 missing authorization on GET /api/system/logs, GET /api/system/logs/stream, and WS /ws/system/logs. Affected <= 4.2.1, patched 4.4.3. NVD vulnStatus is Received, not withdrawn or rejected. GHSA-vw9j-c9ff-mwf8 withdrawn_at is null.

git show fcbe5084a4f095760ac691039ef1999ce50db333 -- internal/router/dashboard.go adds AuthRouterGroup.GET /system/logs, /system/logs/stream and WSRouterGroup.GET /system/logs. Same commit adds GetSystemLogs/WSSubscribeSystemLogs/SSESubscribeSystemLogs in internal/handler/dashboard/dashboard.go (JWT ParseToken only on stream handlers) and GetSystemLogs plus stream methods in internal/service/dashboard/dashboard.go with no ensureAdmin/RequireScopes.

git cat-file -e 51690dd61a629f7a0f1728583c6de55282699e70:internal/router/dashboard.go succeeds; parent file only registers /dashboard/metrics. git grep on the parent for system/logs, GetSystemLogs, SSESubscribeSystemLogs, WSSubscribeSystemLogs returns empty. git log -1 --format='%an %ae %cn %ce' fcbe5084a4f095760ac691039ef1999ce50db333 is L1nSn0w l1nsn0w@qq.com L1nSn0w l1nsn0w@qq.com.

At the BIC, internal/router/router.go AuthRouterGroup uses JWTAuthMiddleware only; setting.go admin-ish routes also lack RequireScopes. git log -S RequireScopes --reverse first hits b47fa1c75d890cd080e3f6699bbfca8cd8d4b939 on 2026-03-23, after this BIC (2026-03-10). fcbe5084 is an ancestor of v4.2.1 and of v4.4.3.

git show 6df5673010720847e35d8bb8f60403e2cc4ab313 -- internal/router/dashboard.go wraps GET /system/logs and GET /system/logs/stream with middleware.RequireScopes(authModel.ScopeAdminSettings) and leaves WS /system/logs on WSRouterGroup. Ancestor of v4.4.3, not of v4.4.2. v4.4.3:internal/router/dashboard.go matches that HTTP/SSE gating. Handler WSSubscribeSystemLogs at the fix still only ParseToken.
reasoning: The advisory is a real missing-authorization bug: system logs are sensitive and were reachable with any valid JWT. The smallest first-write of those endpoints and handlers is fcbe5084; the parent tree has dashboard metrics only and none of the log symbols. That is the BIC, not the later 4.4.3 scope middleware (a fix) and not the 2.x/Huma route moves. The BIC commit object is human L1nSn0w with no AI marker; later AI or fix authorship is ignored. 6df56730 is the vendor 4.4.3 closer for the two HTTP sinks. Verdict NOT_AI.
remaining_gap: 6df56730 / v4.4.3 added ScopeAdminSettings on GET /system/logs and /system/logs/stream but left WS /system/logs as ParseToken-only; vendor still marked 4.4.3 patched. Residual WS authz is outside the BIC/AI judgment.
